items.name: Güemes Open 2022
items.information:
Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! 
El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país.
Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia.
Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores.
Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días. 

*LEER LOS SIGUIENTES APARTADOS*

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta

A pesar de no tener restricciones estrictas con la cantidad de personas que puede asistir y que el lugar es abierto y ventilado, recomendamos no llevar mas de 2 acompañantes para reducir al máximo los riesgos



Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country!
The objective of this competition is to reactivate the northern community of the country.
We will endeavor to enforce all protocols relevant to the pandemic.
Competitors, remember to be punctual, following schedule. We recommend arriving 20 minutes before to avoid inconvenience, especially to new competitors.
This tournament will have 11 official categories and will last 2 days.

*READ THE FOLLOWING TABS*

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta

Despite not having strict restrictions with the number of people who can attend and that the place is open and ventilated, we recommend not to bring more than 2 companions to minimize the risks

items.name: Södertälje New Year 2022
items.information:
# Denna tävling har ställts in på grund av förändrade COVID-19 restriktioner.

Varmt välkommen till Södertälje New Year 2022! 

Se till att läsa igenom alla flikar här på sidan innan du anmäler dig. Där finns mycket viktig information, bland annat om smittskyddsåtgärdena som kommer gälla på tävlingen.

Notera också att medlemmar i SveKub får 25% rabatt! Läs mer om hur det fungerar på fliken SveKub och i anmälan.

# This competition has been cancelled due to a change in COVID-19 restrictions.

Welcome to Södertälje New Year 2022! 

Make sure that you read through all the tabs on this page before registering. They have a lot of important information, including the COVID prevention measures that will be in effect during the competition.

Also note that members of SveKub get a 25% discount! See the tab SveKub and the registration page for more info.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Lexington 2022
items.information:
This is a quiet events competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or looking for more normal events, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other competitions, such as Empire State Winter [A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterA2022) and [B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterB2022).

Please make sure to review the COVID Safety tab. If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case.

items.name: Empire State Winter A 2022
items.information:
This is a series competition with [Empire State Winter B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterB2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Winter B 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, January 1st is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, January 11th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. 
#####
